spec_case: issue #627 (cache tokens sum across a fallback chain's attempts)
description: A json prompt with schema: and provider_fallbacks: [scripted:m2]: a decode-failed attempt then a succeeding one, both reporting cache reads/writes -- each fallback_attempts[] entry carries its own tokens_cached_in/tokens_cache_write, and the pass's own tokens_cached_in_total/tokens_cache_write_total sum both attempts.
